flows.title: Record a purchase and see the work estimate
flows.task: The person wants to record a representative purchase and see how much supply-chain work Behind Your Day estimates behind it.

entry.why: The direct public URL opens on the About page, where the hero explains the estimate and offers Add a purchase.
preconditions: The public site has finished loading its estimation data.
This representative run starts with no saved purchase in the browser.

review.proposal: Start at the public About page because the direct URL capture opens there and the hero is the first place the purchase journey is offered.
review.question: Do people actually begin on About, or do they arrive directly on Add record or Dashboard from another link?
review.basis: Observed direct URL render; audience entry behavior was not measured.

review.proposal: The representative route is About → Add record → Food & drink → Coffee & drinks → amount → Save this record.
review.question: Is the direct hero-to-form route the expected way to reach the estimate, and is any navigation step missing?
review.basis: The route and click order were observed for one representative branch.

review.proposal: The prototype makes Food & drink → Coffee & drinks the walkable representative branch and leaves other categories/items for discussion; the item picker also offers its observed Back route.
review.question: Should every area and item branch lead to the same estimate pattern, and should the other categories be walked before handoff?
alternatives: Walk a second category as a separate complete flow when its estimate context needs comparison.
review.basis: All eight area buttons and three food item labels were seen; only one branch was followed end to end.

review.proposal: No technical failure was observed in this journey; the transient estimation-data loading boundary is documented as a limitation rather than injected as a product branch.
review.basis: Fresh desktop and mobile walks completed without a failure state.

review.proposal: Saving leaves the person on the estimate with SAVED status and a Recent records row; Dashboard is an observed follow-on route but is outside this selected journey.
review.question: Is the saved result the right stopping point, or should the primary journey continue directly into Dashboard?
review.basis: The saved result and Dashboard link were both observed; this artifact intentionally selects the saved-result boundary.

states.title: About / public landing
states.instruction: Start on the public landing page. Ask whether this is where a person begins, then follow the hero's Add a purchase action.

states.title: Add record / area of life
states.instruction: The form asks for a purchase region and area of life. Food & drink is the representative branch captured from the source.

states.title: Food & drink / item picker
states.instruction: Food & drink reveals three item choices. Walk Coffee & drinks for the representative estimate; Back returns to the area grid.

states.title: Coffee & drinks / amount
states.instruction: Review the representative $12 USD amount. The source preview updates live as the amount is entered; this wireframe keeps the value visible and makes Save this record the next declared product action.

states.title: Saved estimate / work behind the purchase
states.instruction: Review the saved result: about 18 minutes, the likely range, leading industries, regional split, and the new Recent records row.

outcome.happened: The $12 USD Coffee & drinks purchase was saved in the browser and its statistical work estimate is shown.
changed: Estimate: none → about 18 minutes of work
